lines.text: Jesus and His disciples went into the Galilean countryside, and John baptized at Aenon near Salim.
A dispute over ceremonial washing arose, and John's disciples told him that everyone was going to Jesus.
John said he was not the Christ, and the friend of the bridegroom is overjoyed to hear his voice.
The One from heaven testifies to what He has seen, and whoever accepts it certifies that God is merciful.
God gives the Spirit without limit, and whoever believes in the Son has eternal life.
